ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 65-70% high-intensity white pixels across the interior fields and 30-35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the margins and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral contiguous white blobs occupy the central lobe regions; low-intensity black pixels form a continuous peripheral band along the trailing edge and radiate in dense, linear 'brush-stroke' patterns from the central notch toward the lobe midpoints.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees; deep vertical penetration into the fluke body relative to the trailing edge plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude variations create a jagged boundary along the entire trailing edge, with distinct peaks and valleys most prominent on the outer-third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave sweep following a parabolic curve from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, textured light pixels (barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the extreme terminal tips of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of dark-on-white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) showing parallel orientation, most visible on the interior white field of the left lobe and lower-mid right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations on both lobe tips; multiple sets of intersecting linear rake marks suggesting external physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated circular dark ring (focal spot) located on the white pixel field of the right lobe, approximately 40% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
